title: Cloaked vs. Optery (2026 Comparison): Which Data Removal Service is Best?
summary: If your top priority is removing your personal information from data brokers, Optery remains the clear leader, offering a deeper, more transparent, and more comprehensive service than Cloaked. If, however, you're looking for an all-in-one privacy toolkit in a single subscription, Cloaked delivers a broader set of capabilities. For consumers who want the strongest data broker removal available without giving up those additional privacy tools, using Optery alongside Cloaked can provide the best of both worlds.
